emulator: native VICE x64sc (headless remote monitor; built executable reports version 3.10)
result_abi: both Q32 and R32, carry, zero-divisor and random/edge inputs
notes: Headless monitor run from full old/new V5 resident images. Uses SEI, CLD, RAM bankout $01=$34 and MATH_INIT at $3280; batches of 128; harness uses absolute JMP not out-of-range relative branch. Does not test hardware REU DMA or provide native cycle timing.
